rawText:
Lady Gaga has reportedly welcomed her first child with her fiancé, Michael Polansky.

The news was reported by PEOPLE and Vogue on September 12, 2026. The couple's first child marks a new chapter for Gaga, who has spoken publicly for years about her dream of becoming a mother.

Gaga and Michael Polansky began their relationship around 2019–2020 and became engaged in 2024. Polansky has generally maintained a private life while supporting Gaga and her career.

Gaga has previously spoken about wanting children and becoming a mother. During a 2025 appearance on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, she described motherhood as a future role she hoped to experience.

Reports about the birth have not publicly confirmed the baby's name or sex. Gaga's representatives had not publicly commented at the time of the initial reports.

The story represents an important personal milestone for Gaga as she begins a new chapter away from the stage and spotlight.
